inventory.name: [NopalCyber] Threat Intelligence Data from Sentinel UEBA2

properties.description:
This rule analyzes BehaviorAnalytics data enriched with Threat Intelligence over the past 90 days to identify Internet Service Providers (ISPs) associated with suspicious brute-force login activity.

It specifically detects IP addresses flagged for unusual failed sign-ins against multiple distinct users (brute force behavior) and aggregates counts by ISP.

The goal is to help SOC teams understand which ISPs are frequently linked to malicious login attempts, providing intelligence for blocking, alerting, or further investigation
properties.displayName: [NopalCyber] Threat Intelligence Data from Sentinel UEBA2
properties.query:
BehaviorAnalytics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
| where DevicesInsights contains "ThreatIntelIndicatorType"
| extend ISP = tostring(DevicesInsights.ISP)
| extend BruteForcer = tostring(ActivityInsights.UnusualNumberOfDistinctUsersFailedSignInFromIPAddress)
| where BruteForcer == "True"
| where ISP != ""
| summarize Count=count() by ISP
| sort by Count desc
